en.headline: 395 own commits and 710 automated ones across 12 repos, plus 27 issue actions
en.teaser: Most of the window went into OpenCode tooling: a skill switchboard, a Go model picker, an agent sandbox knowledge base and a translation extension.
en.overview:
The window ran from 2026-10-16 to 2026-11-14 with data for every day. Grand totals are 395 own commits, 710 automated commits, 0 pull requests, 27 issue actions and 0 reviews. No pull requests or reviews were recorded, so the work shows up as direct commits, releases and issue activity.

### OpenCode tooling

The largest single thread was `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, where the daily activity pipeline was reworked: a `--force` flag to skip the frozen comment-count snapshot, a new AI summary of the last 30 days of GitHub activity with a home-page card and a standalone page, a shared `lib/days.mjs` helper, a fix for missed replies in the early +08 morning hours, and a switch to +08 natural-day windows counting only public data.

`opencode-skill-management` shipped the `skill_management` plugin with list, inspect, disable and enable actions, then went through four releases (0.1.0-rc.0, 0.1.0-rc.1, 0.2.0, 1.0.0, 1.1.0 and 1.2.0 among them) that moved the tool to a single JSON envelope with a declared output schema, fixed a false divergence warning in `list`, and corrected frontmatter boolean parsing.

`opencode-go-model-picker` reached 1.4.0, 2.0.0, 3.0.0 and 3.0.1: shared JSON and proxy helpers, fuller agent discovery with `skippedBuiltins`, priced accounting in `references/quota-math.md`, a large documentation cut in 3.0.0, and an enforced candidate menu with per-source chains in 3.0.1.

### Other projects

`opencode-agent-sandbox` accumulated a knowledge base covering OpenCode V2 distribution, architecture and auth, Windows path pitfalls, remote branch deletion risks and an `opencode-provider` category. `sopen-translate` was started from scratch as an MV3 extension with bilingual page rendering, chunk splitting, a circuit breaker, a provider protocol layer and glossary pipeline, then narrowed to page translation only.

`pixel-logo-toolkit` gained automatic text wrapping with overflow protection, a bilingual CLI, a 40-image command gallery and a Korean font fix, shipping v0.2.0 and v0.3.0. `dsh-ecosystem-report` got mobile viewport fixes at 375 and 414 px, a single-button theme menu, visual refinements and a GitHub repository button. `myBlog` received two documentation screenshots, and `dsh-openchamber-plugins` got one commit porting OpenChamber features.

### Upstream issue work

Issue activity was concentrated upstream. In `anomalyco/opencode` the topics were MiMo-V2.6-Flash vision and subagent failures, image input rejected by the Go endpoint, and the Windows desktop shipping a CLI with no way to run it. In `openchamber/openchamber` the reports covered MCP server visibility, session retention hints, quote-card navigation, line-number drag selection, the project actions menu and orphaned MCP child processes. One issue was opened in `microsoft/PowerToys` about a NullReferenceException in Shortcut Guide hold-Win activation.

highlights.text: v1.0.0 froze the skill_management surface for 1.x after the 0.1.0-rc and 0.2.0 pre-releases.
3.0.0 cut the model-facing documentation from 104,181 to 8,291 characters.
v0.3.0 added automatic line wrapping and overflow protection with a 9px font floor.
Opened and closed a temporary smoke-test issue for the opencode /oc command.
Reported that mimo-v2.6-flash and mimo-v2.5 advertise image input while the Go endpoint rejects every image with 400.
Reported that Settings > MCP omits the Console MCP server OpenCode adds at runtime.
Opened a Shortcut Guide report about a NullReferenceException on hold-Win activation.

zh.headline: 12 个仓库共 395 次本人提交、710 次自动提交，另有 27 次 issue 互动
zh.teaser: 本期主要投入 OpenCode 工具链：技能开关插件、Go 模型选择器、Agent 沙箱知识库和一个翻译扩展。
zh.overview:
本期窗口为 2026-10-16 至 2026-11-14，30 天均有数据。总计 395 次本人提交、710 次自动提交、0 个 PR、27 次 issue 互动（新开、关闭或评论）、0 次评审。没有 PR 和评审记录，工作主要体现在直接提交、发布和 issue 互动上。

### OpenCode 工具链

投入最多的是 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`，日常活动流水线被重做：新增 `--force` 跳过评论数快照冻结，新增近 30 天 GitHub 活动 AI 总结（首页卡片加独立页），抽出共享助手 `lib/days.mjs`，修复 +08 凌晨漏采回复，并把活动卡片改为 +08 自然日窗口、只统计公开数据。

`opencode-skill-management` 实现了 `skill_management` 插件的 list、inspect、disable、enable 四个动作，期间发布 0.1.0-rc.0、0.1.0-rc.1、0.2.0、1.0.0、1.1.0 和 1.2.0，把四个动作统一为带输出 schema 的单个 JSON 对象，修掉了 `list` 误报技能分歧的问题，并纠正了 frontmatter 布尔值解析。

`opencode-go-model-picker` 先后发布 1.4.0、2.0.0、3.0.0 和 3.0.1：共享 JSON 与代理助手、更完整的 agent 发现（含 `skippedBuiltins`）、`references/quota-math.md` 的计价核算、3.0.0 的大幅文档精简，以及 3.0.1 的候选菜单强制校验和按来源决定链长。

### 其他项目

`opencode-agent-sandbox` 积累知识库，覆盖 OpenCode V2 的分发、架构与认证、Windows 路径坑、远程分支删除风险，并新增 `opencode-provider` 类别。`sopen-translate` 从零起步，做成 MV3 扩展，具备双语页面渲染、分块、熔断、进度、provider 协议层与术语表流水线，之后收敛为只做页面翻译。

`pixel-logo-toolkit` 加入自动折行与溢出保护、中英双语命令行、40 张命令示例画廊，并修正韩语字体，发布 v0.2.0 和 v0.3.0。`dsh-ecosystem-report` 修复 375 与 414 视口的移动端适配，主题切换改为单按钮弹出菜单，做了视觉精修并加上 GitHub 仓库按钮。`myBlog` 补了两张文档截图，`dsh-openchamber-plugins` 有一次移植 OpenChamber 功能的提交。

### 上游 issue

issue 互动集中在上游。`anomalyco/opencode` 的话题包括 MiMo-V2.6-Flash 的视觉与子代理失败、Go 端点拒绝图片输入，以及 Windows 桌面版自带 CLI 却无法运行。`openchamber/openchamber` 报告了 MCP 服务器可见性、会话保留提示、引用卡片跳转、行号拖选、项目操作菜单和残留 MCP 子进程等问题。`microsoft/PowerToys` 开了一个关于 Shortcut Guide 按住 Win 激活抛 NullReferenceException 的 issue。

highlights.text: v1.0.0 在 0.1.0-rc 与 0.2.0 预发布之后冻结了 skill_management 的 1.x 接口。
3.0.0 把模型需要阅读的文档从 104,181 字符压到 8,291 字符。
v0.3.0 加入自动折行与溢出保护，字号下限为 9px。
新开并关闭了一个用于验证 opencode /oc 命令的临时冒烟测试 issue。
报告 mimo-v2.6-flash 与 mimo-v2.5 声明支持图片输入，但 Go 端点对所有图片返回 400。
报告设置中的 MCP 页面漏掉了 OpenCode 运行时添加的 Console MCP 服务器。
新开 Shortcut Guide 按住 Win 激活抛 NullReferenceException 的报告。
